# How to get up to \$2,500 in OpenAI API credits as an indie founder

(Research updated November 17, 2026)

There is a potentially useful route for indie founders: **the Ramp startup offer**, which has been listed as providing up to \$2,500 in OpenAI API credits.

However, there are different OpenAI startup-credit programs, and the distinction matters: OpenAI's main startup program currently routes credits through eligible venture-capital partners rather than offering a universal application to every indie developer.

Here's how to approach it.

## 1\. The \$2,500 route: Ramp

![Expensify vs. Slash vs. Ramp: Which Platform Fits Your Team?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dBf_kwO40HGC1MeF-Nmb9QFxHeQuqGeTZQFVy_Eos2NsaD63J9yi5SwK31UTUoiCz5qjWc0Eyt4_gv7AtVDv5TsVR4UWyocR78rqhoecNMhOOzXvgTNyVHFyt5AyYX26WHczYJRTKz5tLJg8PnSdnfdF_uvpRONr4RmSvJ6FUXnOIZoDA-567viCaKS95NuR?purpose=fullsize)

**Ramp startup benefits**

# Up to \$2,500

Reported OpenAI API credit offer

The reported route is\:

1. Open a Ramp account.
2. Check the Ramp Rewards marketplace.
3. Look for the OpenAI API credits offer.
4. Check the eligibility and redemption requirements.
5. Redeem the offer if it is available to your account.

**Important\:** I found third-party listings for this offer, but haven't established that it is currently available to every indie founder. Treat the \$2,500 as a potential benefit, not a guaranteed grant.

The good news is that Ramp has a dedicated OpenAI rewards page\:

**Apply through Ramp**  (Official partner page)

# Up to \$2,500

OpenAI API credits for startups

[Visit OpenAI credits offer](https://ramp.com/rewards/openai)

Ramp's dedicated offer page advertises the \$2,500 maximum. Confirm the amount and eligibility during signup.

Source: [ramp.com](https://ramp.com/rewards/openai?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[ramp.com](https://ramp.com/rewards?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2\. OpenAI's official startup program
![OpenAI just launched “OpenAI for Startups.”

A program built for ambitious founders to accelerate their startup journey by providing the right AI tools, technical resources, and a collaborative… | Ansh Mehra | 11 comments](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/iCTw_7usplIg7ahwM4rap1UZ70msqNoyNdNZfyC3EdR0_2t4P8xqxjaGCDK2KgvInrYgEBhARwLXqWaBQKMLmzI3-ARrfXAjRgiAJI485a2vR193MQXlTykYBsg15rpQ58Ltx8qqEAgH_yoXTkRXPdLHyci3haU2CkKi8f1dFdEkRdDRq2wRqg4pf3g-GJz1?purpose=fullsize)

OpenAI offers startup benefits through its VC partner network.

Some named partners include\:

- Sequoia Capital
- Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
- Thrive Capital
- Kleiner Perkins
- Conviction Partners

If your startup is backed by an eligible partner, you may qualify for\:

- Free API credits.
- Increased API rate limits.
- Technical support from OpenAI engineers.
- Startup events and founder resources.

**How to apply\:**

1. Contact your VC and request an OpenAI referral code.
2. Create an OpenAI API account.
3. Prepare a description of your product and intended API usage.
4. Provide your company details, business email and basic funding information.
5. Submit the application using your referral code.

No pitch deck is required.

Official application information: [OpenAI for Startups](https://openai.com/business/why-openai/startups/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\. [openai.com](https://openai.com/business/why-openai/startups/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[openai.com](https://openai.com/form/vc-partnerships-application/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 3\. Another opportunity: ChatGPT subscription API credits

OpenAI also has a separate API credit benefit for eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers.

| Subscription | Monthly API credits |
|--------|--------|
| Pro (\$100) | \$100 |
| Pro (\$200) | \$200 |
| Pro (\$500) | \$500 |
| Business Standard | \$20 per paid seat |
| Business Premium | \$100 per paid seat |


These are separate from startup grants. Eligibility and activation requirements apply. [developers.openai.com](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/chatgpt-api-credits?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Official details: [API credits for ChatGPT subscribers](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/chatgpt-api-credits?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=chatgpt.com)\.

---

## 4\. What I'd recommend for an indie founder

I'd pursue the Ramp offer first because it has a dedicated public signup page, without requiring you to first establish a relationship with a VC.

Then investigate OpenAI's startup community and any eligible partner referrals.

You can also join the [OpenAI Startup Community](https://openai.com/startups?utm_source=chatgpt.com) for technical resources and founder events.

## 5\. Let's figure out which route you qualify for
